notes.title: Update 1.0.1.1
notes.content: This update has expanded upon achievements and also has very minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 out now!
notes.content:
We have added many new features and bugfixes such as:

[olist]
Fixing gameplay in every level in the game

Adding in more controller support

Several art redesigns

Added in a new achievement

Fixed crashes in the main menu

Improved level consistency

Fixed the Freeplay button's font

Fixed in game text fonts
[/olist]
This update is the biggest update we have done yet, so please try it out!
